items.title: Reggie Watkins interviewed by Monk Rowe, Utica, New York, May 22, 2018
items.q: The musical director at the time was my old friend from Maynard’s band, Carl Fischer

ctx.x: So I was subbing onto that band. I don’t know if I did eight or ten gigs with them. The musical director at the time was my old friend from Maynard’s band, Carl Fischer, who is now a featured trumpet player with Billy Joel. So he left his position with Blood, Sweat & Tears and he’s got plenty to do with Billy Joel and other things. But yeah, so that was — I appreciate those kind of experiences.
